d:
Temerario means reckless. Lamborghini's V10 replacement has a twin-turbo V8 and a plug-in hybrid system with three electric motors, and it's somehow wilder than the car before it.
In this video, we drive the Lamborghini Temerario to find out whether downsizing and hybridisation have taken the emotion out of the baby Lambo. We look at how the electric motors fill in torque while the big turbos spool up, what launch control feels like, how the chassis and adaptive dampers have turned it into a proper weapon in the corners, and the one thing it lost from the V10.
